mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with temperatures around 42 degrees under the New Moon.

City officials are currently focused on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, storm sewers, and new concrete sidewalks between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
There is plenty to do in town, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, all happening today.
In a report from October 19, a local man was taken into custody on an active arrest warrant after being stopped for driving with a suspended license.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
